scenarios.name: printer
paraphrases: A printer fault is either a worn roller or a sensor fault. Both occur equally often in this device.
For this printer, a worn roller and a sensor fault are equally common possible causes of the malfunction.
scenarios.contrast: strong minus weak likelihood ratio, same direction

scenarios.name: seedling
paraphrases: A seedling problem is either low light or excess water. Prior inspection leaves the two causes equally likely.
Inspection of a struggling seedling has left low light and excess water with equal prior probability.
scenarios.contrast: strong minus weak likelihood ratio, same direction

scenarios.name: parcel
paraphrases: A delayed parcel is either at the local depot or at the regional hub. Tracking before today gives each location a 50% chance.
Before today’s check, a late parcel was equally likely to be at the local depot or the regional hub.
scenarios.contrast: strong minus weak likelihood ratio, same direction

scenarios.name: sound
paraphrases: A recording’s noise comes either from a cable or from a microphone. The technician’s prior evidence gives equal chances to these sources.
A technician initially considers a bad cable and a bad microphone equally likely sources of noise in a recording.
scenarios.contrast: strong minus weak likelihood ratio, same direction

scenarios.name: artifact
paraphrases: An artifact was produced either in workshop L or in workshop M. Before inspecting its mark, both origins are equally likely.
An artifact has two possible origins, workshop L and workshop M, with equal probabilities before its mark is examined.
scenarios.contrast: strong minus weak likelihood ratio, same direction

scenarios.name: network
paraphrases: A network delay originates either in a router or in an application. Earlier checks give these explanations equal probability.
Previous checks leave a router problem and an application problem equally likely causes of network delay.
scenarios.contrast: strong minus weak likelihood ratio, same direction

scenarios.name: kitchen
paraphrases: One kitchen worker must prepare dough A for one slot, bake B for two consecutive slots, and label jars C for one slot. Preparation must finish before baking starts; idle gaps between tasks are allowed.

A single kitchen worker needs one slot for dough preparation A, two uninterrupted slots for baking B, and one slot for labeling C. Baking starts after preparation finishes; idle gaps between tasks are allowed.
scenarios.contrast: slot 4 unavailable versus slot 2; condition on initial affected status

scenarios.name: audio
paraphrases: One audio worker must record narration A, mix B, and edit the music C. Both recording and music editing must finish before mixing. Each task takes one slot.
For one audio worker, mixing B requires both recorded narration A and edited music C. Each job takes one slot.
scenarios.contrast: slot 3 unavailable versus slot 2; condition on initial affected status

scenarios.name: garden
paraphrases: One gardener must mark beds A, plant B, and water C, in that order. Each job takes one slot.
Marking beds A must finish before planting B, which must finish before watering C. One gardener performs the three one-slot jobs.
scenarios.contrast: slot 4 unavailable versus slot 2; condition on initial affected status

scenarios.name: exhibit
paraphrases: One exhibit worker must mount labels A, pack stands B, and approve label wording C. Approval must finish before labels are mounted; packing is independent. Each task takes one slot.
For one exhibit worker, approval C precedes mounting labels A. Packing stands B may occur anywhere. Every task takes one slot.
scenarios.contrast: slot 3 unavailable versus slot 2; condition on initial affected status

scenarios.name: equipment
paraphrases: One technician must calibrate A before testing B. A delivery check C must occur in slot 4. All three tasks take one slot.
A technician has calibration A, sample test B, and delivery check C. Calibration precedes testing, and the one-slot delivery check is fixed at slot 4; the other jobs also take one slot.
scenarios.contrast: slot 3 unavailable versus slot 2; condition on initial affected status

scenarios.name: publication
paraphrases: One publishing worker must proofread A and clear image permissions C before publishing B. Publication is available only in slot 4 or 5. Each task takes one slot.
Publication B requires completed proofreading A and permission clearance C, and can occur only in slots 4 or 5. A single worker performs each task in one slot.
scenarios.contrast: slot 3 unavailable versus slot 2; condition on initial affected status
